diagnosis.summary: Infrastructure and model integration diagnosis for Ollama and RAG

details.ollama: Ollama endpoints returned 404 or session-closed errors in runtime logs; likely causes: Ollama not running, mismatched API path (v1/generate vs /api/generate), or service instability.
details.rag: RAG initialization failed: 'chromadb' vector store not available. Either install/enable chromadb or configure an available vector store.
details.rules: `rules/architecture_rules.json` is present; earlier smoke failure was due to running from a different working directory. Confirm permanent placement under data/experience/i-project/rules or set working-dir when running scripts.
details.environment: Some pytest/import issues were previously resolved by adjusting PYTHONPATH and installing missing deps; ensure `.venv` activation and consistent PYTHONPATH in CI and local runs.

blockers: Ollama service unreachable or API endpoint mismatch (causes model calls to 404/Session closed)
RAG vector store 'chromadb' not available in environment
Potential config path/type mismatch in `config/local_models.yaml` for logs or other paths (reported as a type error in integrity checks)
recommended_actions: Verify and start Ollama service locally (or update `OLLAMA_HOST`/API base in settings).
Either install `chromadb` into the environment or change RAG vector_store config to an available option.
Confirm `rules/architecture_rules.json` resides at `data/experience/i-project/rules/architecture_rules.json` or run smoke scripts from the i-project folder.
Fix central config path/type issues in `config/local_models.yaml` (logs path type); then re-run `check_system_integrity.py`.
After the above, run smoke checks and the semaphore test in order: `smoke_ollama.py`, `smoke_aider.py`, `test_ollama_semaphore.py`.
